# Mendeley

> Mendeley is a comprehensive research management platform combining reference management, citation tools, data repository access, and AI-powered research features.

Mendeley provides researchers with integrated tools for organizing citations, managing research data, and collaborating on academic work. The platform includes Mendeley Desktop, Mendeley Cite, Mendeley Data, and AI-enhanced features like the Reading Assistant and Ask My Library.

## Key Topics

- Reference Management
- Mendeley Desktop
- Mendeley Cite
- Mendeley Data
- Citation Tools
- AI Features
- Web Importer
- Real-Time Sync
- Reading Assistant
- Ask My Library
- Research Collaboration
- Account Authentication
- Data Repository
- Elsevier Integration
- ScienceDirect

## Core Products & Access

- [Mendeley Library](https://www.mendeley.com/library): Login portal and account access for your Mendeley research library
- [Mendeley Data](https://data.mendeley.com): Research dataset repository and search platform for discovering and publishing research data
- [Pricing Plans](https://www.mendeley.com/pricing): Subscription tiers and pricing information for Mendeley products and features

## Documentation & Guides

- [Guides](https://www.mendeley.com/guides): Comprehensive guides and documentation for Mendeley tools and features
- [Developer Portal](http://dev.mendeley.com): Mendeley API documentation and resources for developer integration

## Product Updates & Announcements

- [Mendeley Blog](https://blog.mendeley.com): Official blog hub for product updates, feature releases, and research tips
- [Real-Time Sync in Mendeley Cite](https://blog.mendeley.com/2024/12/27/real-time-sync-is-now-in-mendeley-cite): Announcement of real-time synchronization feature for Mendeley Cite
- [Seamless Mendeley Updates](https://blog.mendeley.com/2025/05/15/experience-a-seamless-mendeley-faster-and-bug-free): Web Importer improvements and bug fixes for enhanced performance
- [Mendeley Desktop Support Continuation](https://blog.mendeley.com/2025/07/09/mendeley-is-not-going-anywhere): Product announcement confirming ongoing support for Mendeley Desktop

## Community & Support

- [Mendeley Advisor Community](https://www.mendeley.com/advisor-community): Ambassador program and community network for Mendeley Advisors
